# Rama Winding Wires

> Rama Winding Wires is the brand of Raghupati Wires India Private Limited, a manufacturer of enamelled copper, aluminium, submersible, bare and colored winding wire at I.D.A. Jeedimetla, Hyderabad, Telangana, India. Wire is drawn from 99.99% ETP copper, coated on European enamelling lines, and made to IS 13730, IEC 60317 and NEMA MW, in thermal classes from 130 to 220 °C and gauges SWG 8 to 43.

Contact: info@ramacopper.com (sales), tech-support@ramacopper.com (specifications), +91 90522 40000. Address: Plot No. 61/D Part-1, Road No. 15, Phase-1, Next to Pipe Line Road, I.D.A. Jeedimetla, Hyderabad, Telangana 500055, India.

To request a quote, send the conductor diameter or SWG, covering grade, thermal class and volume.

## Products

- [Enamelled Copper Wire](https://ramacopper.com/enamelled-copper-wire.html): 99.99% ETP copper, SWG 8 to 43, polyester, polyesterimide or polyamide-imide enamel, Class 130 to 220, for motors, generators and transformers.
- [Submersible Copper Winding Wire](https://ramacopper.com/submersible-copper-winding-wire.html): polyester film wrapped copper, 0.50 to 3.00 mm, stable to 200 °C, for borewell and open well pump motors.
- [Aluminium Winding Wire](https://ramacopper.com/aluminium-winding-wire.html): 99.7% EC grade aluminium, SWG 10 to 36, polyester or polyesterimide enamel to Class 200, for transformers, fans and appliance motors.
- [Bare Copper Wire](https://ramacopper.com/bare-copper-wire.html): 99.99% ETP copper, cadmium free, 0.10 to 4.00 mm, hard, half hard or annealed.
- [Colored Copper Wire](https://ramacopper.com/colored-copper-wire.html): colour coded enamelled copper, SWG 18 to 40, for lead identification and craft.

## Technical data

- [Technical data](https://ramacopper.com/technical.html): covering thickness by grade for SWG 8 to 43 with conductor resistance, submersible wire parameters, aluminium SWG to AWG conversions, and enamel types with thermal class and IS, IEC and NEMA references.

## Applications

- [Electric mobility](https://ramacopper.com/electric-mobility.html): winding wire for EV traction motors, chargers and auxiliaries.
- [Automotive](https://ramacopper.com/automotive.html): wire for the small motors, solenoids and sensor coils in a car.
- [Drive technology](https://ramacopper.com/drive-technology.html): inverter duty wire for motors fed by variable frequency drives.
- [Energy transmission](https://ramacopper.com/energy-transmission.html): copper and aluminium wire for distribution transformers.
- [Renewable energy](https://ramacopper.com/renewable-energy.html): wire for wind generators, solar inverters and solar pumps.
- [White goods and power tools](https://ramacopper.com/white-goods-power-tools.html): wire for appliance motors, compressors and power tools.
